Intake asks the customer to confirm conflicting or

Submit gate blocks incomplete cases. Persist moves the case to

Review graph validates across documents, screens the watchlist,
scores risk from versioned rules, drafts a redacted summary.
Graph interrupts. The case waits in the analyst queue, lowest
score first. Nothing automated can approve or reject.
Analyst inspects rendered pages, extracted fields and evidence,
then decides. decide_case() alone writes the final status.
Outcome is posted to the customer chat. Every step above is
appended to the hash-chained audit log.
